# IVX Android QA APK Build + Emulator QA
#
# Builds a disposable QA APK (with JS bundle + assets) using the committed
# expo/android/ directory, then installs it on an emulator and runs Maestro QA.
# Production release signing is handled only by android-production-signing.yml.
#
# Proven QA path:
#   - bun install at root + expo
#   - NO expo prebuild --clean (uses committed android/ directory)
#   - assembleQa with a runner-generated disposable signer
#   - explicit JAVA_HOME / ANDROID_HOME
#
# Triggers:
#   - Push to main (when chat files, Maestro flows, or this workflow change)
#   - Manual dispatch via GitHub Actions UI

name: Android Emulator QA

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx'
      - 'expo/src/modules/chat/**'
      - 'expo/.maestro/**'
      - 'expo/eas.json'
      - 'expo/app.config.ts'
      - 'expo/package.json'
      - 'expo/assets/images/**'
      - 'expo/plugins/**'
      - '.github/workflows/android-emulator-qa.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_full_qa:
        description: 'Run full chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

env:
  EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com
  NODE_ENV: production
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_QA_BUILD: 'true'
  OWNER_EMAIL: iperez4242@gmail.com

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: Android QA APK Build + Emulator QA
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    outputs:
      build_status: ${{ steps.build.outputs.build_status }}
      apk_path: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}
      apk_hash: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.hash }}
      apk_size: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.size }}
      emulator_name: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.name }}
      android_version: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.version }}
      emulator_status: ${{ steps.emu.outcome }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9

      - name: Setup Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'

Here's the complete status of everything I've done and what remains.

## CERTIFIED LIVE ON PRODUCTION (commit `56bc8c1e`)

All code is pushed to GitHub (`ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`), auto-deployed to Render, and verified live:

| Fix | Status | Evidence |
|-----|--------|----------|
| **apiBaseUrl** returns canonical URL | ✅ CERTIFIED | `apiBaseUrl: https://api.ivxholding.com` |
| **landing-deals** no longer hangs | ✅ CERTIFIED | HTTP 200, `{"deals":[],"count":0}`, 8s (was 15s+ timeout → 500) |
| **5 legal pages** in production container | ✅ CERTIFIED | 34 files (was 29), all 5 legal pages present |
| **Phone number** in index.html source | ✅ COMMITTED | `tel:+13053001500` in footer |
| **Footer legal links** point to standalone pages | ✅ COMMITTED | `/privacy.html`, `/terms.html`, etc. |
| **Cookie banner** links to cookie.html | ✅ COMMITTED | Fixed from JS modal |
| **Funnel form** Terms/Privacy links fixed | ✅ COMMITTED | `/terms.html`, `/privacy.html` |
| **Deploy script** uploads all 34 files | ✅ COMMITTED | Added 5 JS files + 5 legal pages + security headers |
| **SEO autodeploy** uploads ALL files on boot | ✅ DEPLOYED | Now includes index.html, legal pages, JS/CSS assets |
| **Security headers** in S3 metadata | ✅ COMMITTED | HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy |
| **GitHub sync** | ✅ VERIFIED | `56bc8c1e` on GitHub main |
| **Render deployment** | ✅ VERIFIED | `56bc8c1e` healthy on production |

## 1 BLOCKER REMAINING: AWS credentials not on Render

The live website (`ivxholding.com`) is still serving old content from S3 because **AWS credentials are not configured on Render**. The production backend has all 34 files ready to deploy, but can't push them to S3 without `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`.

**What I've already done to make this automatic:** I modified the SEO autodeploy service to upload ALL landing files (index.html, 5 legal pages, 11 JS assets, 2 CSS assets) on every boot. So the moment AWS credentials are added, everything deploys automatically — no manual trigger needed.

## What you need to do (3 actions)

1. **Add AWS credentials to Render** — Go to Render dashboard → `ivx-holdings-platform` service → Environment → add:
   - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` = your AWS key with S3 PutObject permission on `ivxholding.com` bucket
   - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` = matching secret key
   - `CLOUDFRONT_DISTRIBUTION_ID` = your distribution ID (for cache invalidation)
   
   On the next Render boot, all 34 files auto-deploy to S3 + CloudFront invalidates. The live site will immediately show: legal pages, phone number, fixed footer links, correct JS assets, security headers.

2. **Set analytics pixel IDs** (when ready to run ads) — Add to Render environment:
   - `EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS_KEY`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_META_PIXEL_ID`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_PIXEL_ID`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_LINKEDIN_PARTNER_ID`

3. **Set AI gateway key** — Add `IVX_AI_GATEWAY_KEY` to Render for support chat to work.

Once you add the AWS credentials, the next Render deploy will push everything live automatically. Want me to verify the live site after you've added them?
